operasyon-aksam.source: The original iOS application runs in the simulator. Today and tomorrow scores use live weather through the original DEBUG fallback. Equipment selection and the bottom rig guide are shown. Location permission was declined and the built in Karaburun location was used. Notification delivery and production WeatherKit entitlements were not tested.

busted.source: The video is the original repository demonstration of the alert sequence. The separate copy uses the original startup and detection engines, and all 92 core tests pass. Live camera detection, Bluetooth proximity and Telegram delivery were not exercised in this review.

kipirda.source: The original Mac application was built and signed. The recording shows working hours, work rhythm, maximum blocking time and profile settings. The portfolio copy uses separate local storage and pairing credentials. Phone pairing, movement detection and the break overlay were not verified in this recording.

etsy-factory.source: The original Mac application uses its Python backend with an isolated snapshot of the existing local database and artwork files. The backend returned 12 product types and 71 designs. The recording shows catalog navigation and existing listing images. New artwork generation, mockup rendering and remote publishing were not exercised.
